'''Estan Carolinden''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the [[Intarsa League]] criminal faction during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Carolinden and the League were aboard a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] traveling close to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] when they were attacked by a rival group of criminals and crashed in the grounds of the [[Blue Star Centre]], a [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophical]] research facility. Carolinden and the Intarsa League entered the facility and took its inhabitants hostage in an attempt to gain passage off of Cularin. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelancers who operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], [[Skirmish in the Blue Star Centre|attacked]] the Intarsa League and defeated Carolinden and his compatriots to free the hostages.
